purpose: Measure first-hit Lift success under different open-loop action execution lengths using the completed ALT-30 checkpoint and memory bank.

fixed_inputs.success_signal: RoboSuite Lift task predicate: cube z > table_offset_z + 0.04 m

execution_protocol.retrieval: cosine top-1 from the same frozen ALT-30 memory bank
execution_protocol.policy_inputs: current agentview RGB, current wrist RGB, and current robot proprioception only
execution_protocol.chunk_definition: retrieve once, execute up to K consecutive stored 7D actions from that matched episode, then re-observe and query again
execution_protocol.success_handling: check the environment success predicate after every individual executed action; stop immediately at the first true result
execution_protocol.success_signal_visibility: evaluator stop/scoring only; never supplied to the policy
execution_protocol.failed_rollout_handling: continue until success, environment termination, or the unchanged 1000-step cap
execution_protocol.episode_boundary: never cross into another demonstration episode; preserve same-episode last-action padding and record executed padding
execution_protocol.training: no retraining; same model seed 42 checkpoint and same bank for all variants

pilot.purpose: Validate chunk execution and success-triggered stop before the full paired 50-seed runs; pilot rows are excluded from formal success-rate aggregation.

reference.note: The existing one-action-per-query run logs first-success steps and uses the same fixed seeds. Its ever-success results are the K=1 first-hit reference; the original fixed-horizon metrics remain unchanged.

reporting.primary_metric: fraction of fixed evaluation seeds that reached the frozen Lift height predicate before the cap
reporting.model_seed_uncertainty: not measured; this is one checkpoint across paired evaluation seeds
reporting.interpretation_limit: first-hit success measures task completion, not sustained holding or policy-learned termination
